name: nftgiftcase
description: Telegram Mini App: digital gift cases, Stars payments, upgrades and event pass.

scripts.db:local: wrangler d1 execute nftgiftcase-db --local --file=./db/0001_initial.sql && wrangler d1 execute nftgiftcase-db --local --file=./db/0002_case_builder.sql
scripts.db:remote: wrangler d1 execute nftgiftcase-db --remote --file=./db/0001_initial.sql && wrangler d1 execute nftgiftcase-db --remote --file=./db/0002_case_builder.sql
scripts.check: node --check backend/app.js && node --check backend/worker.js && node --check frontend/app.js
